correctness.rationale: For W=0^a1^b0^c1^d with all four runs positive, the descending digram 10 appears once, and any longer factor containing 10 cannot be minimally unique. Every remaining factor is either unary or 0^i1^j. Unary occurrence formulas yield precisely the unequal longest 0/1 runs; two 01 transition boundaries yield candidate extensions exactly when |a-c|>=2 or |b-d|>=2, with no mixed i,j>=2 candidate. This exhaustively proves five possible MUFs and count 1+1_{a!=c}+1_{b!=d}+1_{|a-c|>=2}+1_{|b-d|>=2}. Independent literal overlapping factor enumeration verified full predicted factor set for all 4^4=256 run-length quadruples a,b,c,d<=4. The independent-pair enumerator P(z,t) yields bivariate F=2tP², sharp max min(5,n-3) and first five at n=8; finite tests are corroboration only.
residual_risks: The complete all-positive-run proof rests on explicit occurrence formulas, rather than finite checks alone.
